title: A Blue Hour for the Wardrobe
author: Ivo Marchetti
blurb: Silas Blackwood, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
